BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — MOCK EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Fixings and Fittings, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Fixings and Fittings.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fixings and Fittings.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fixings and Fittings.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fixings and Fittings.

2. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Pre-cast Concrete Products.

4. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

5. When learning Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Careers and Entrepreneurship in Building Construction.

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Material Schedules.

7. When learning Wall Finishes, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Wall Finishes.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Wall Finishes.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Wall Finishes.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Wall Finishes.

8. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. CPU
   C. Speaker
   D. Keyboard

9. When learning Building Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Building Drawing.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Building Drawing.

   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Floor Finishes.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Floor Finishes.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Floor Finishes.

12. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Run with the tool

13. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. International Cricket Team

14. When learning Waste Water Disposal, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Introduction to Building Drawing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Building Drawing.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Computer Aided Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
